newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech major shares rally briefly then swing lower.
newsitem.headline: Czech major shares rally briefly then swing lower.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index closed lower on Thursday for the seventh straight session after a brief midday rally by some major issues gave way to renewed pessimism about the short term prospects for the blue chips.
The PX50 closed down 3.4 points, 0.6 percent, to 581.3 while the major issue dominated RPIX index ended the day down 5.3 points, 0.43 percent to 1,216.4.

Around mid-session in continuous trading, CEZ was up eight crowns at 1,109 while Komercni Banka had risen 35 crowns to 2,570. Komercni ended the day two crowns lower at 2,533 and CEZ closed down 11 crowns at 1,090.
Explaining Thursday's volatility, Jan Sykora of Wood and Company said: "There are such thin volumes, there is no depth in the market. So it takes little to move the market."
Sykora added that investors still saw little opportunity to find cheap blue chip buying opportunities on the Prague bourse.
"The PX50 could easily go down 5-6 percent," he said.
SPT Telecom closed five crowns lower at 3,645, while Ceska Sporitelna was again unchanged on 318.
Overall on the bourse, turnover was little changed at 1.6 billion crowns.
